profile.name: Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust

intro.text: Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust (the “Company”) was formed as a Maryland statutory trust on January 23, 2026 (the “Date of Formation”) and intends to qualify as a real estate investment trust (“REIT”) for U.S. federal income tax purposes. The Company was organized primarily to acquire, own, and manage a portfolio of core and core-plus student housing properties. The Company wholly owns and is the general partner of Core University Living REIT OP, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the “Operating Partnership”). Substantially all of the Company’s business is conducted through the Operating Partnership. Core University Living REIT SLP, LLC (the “Special Limited Partner”), an affiliate of Core Spaces, LLC (the “Sponsor”), holds a performance participation interest in the Operating Partnership.
